title: Render to Reason: Novel-View Semantic Prediction Improves Spatial Understanding in VLMs
abstract: Recent works augment Vision-Language Models with geometry features from pretrained 3D models, expecting that the geometric signal will boost spatial reasoning. However, we find that simply fusing geometry features and training on standard spatial QA yields only marginal improvements on high-level multi-hop tasks. We attribute this gap to a training-signal problem: standard spatial QA can be largely answered from visual features and language priors, so the geometry pathway receives weak gradients and fails to integrate with the visual features. To provide a training signal that requires geometry, we propose \textbf{novel-view semantic rendering} as an auxiliary training task that requires the model to predict the semantic layout of an unobserved viewpoint, inspired by humans' ability to mentally simulate novel viewpoints during spatial reasoning. This task encourages joint use of both pathways: geometry provides pose-dependent visibility, while vision provides semantic content. Our auxiliary task yields consistent improvements over the geometry-augmented baseline across all three benchmarks (up to +1.6 on VSI-Bench, +2.2 on ReVSI, +2.9 on our 3D-Point-QA dataset) and our full model surpasses prior open-source methods on VSI-Bench and on ReVSI. Project page: https://yuqunw.github.io/Render2Reason/.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.05417v2 的 18 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：available。 本次实质更新：VSI Table1 Qwen平均74.4改为75.3、八个子项全部修订；正文排名差值同步。方法、ReVSI和ablation无科学变化；作为结果更正发布，不称新方法。
analysis.ideaZh: Render2Reason v2 实际修正VSI-Bench主表：Qwen variant平均74.4→75.3，绝对距离64.1→65.8、relative direction88.4→94.0等，部分子项也下降。方法仍是novel-view semantic rendering辅助任务，促VLM使用geometry；这是需同步canonical结果的版本更正，不是新方法或统一提升。
analysis.motivationZh: 更新已收录R2R的VSI-Bench结果，并核对辅助几何监督的证据边界。
analysis.methodZh: 视觉tokens与VGGT geometry/camera features以gated cross attention融合，联合QA与256 query tokens的16×16九类novel-view semantic map预测。v2仅修订Qwen VSI row及相应文字；ReVSI54.5、组件ablation、data/protocol未改。
methodFlow: 多视角visual与VGGT geometry/camera tokens融合
target view只保留camera token，256learned queries预测16×16semantic grid
本轮以exact v1对照更新主表数值和canonical版本
analysis.experimentsZh: 394K spatial QA和100K semantic rendering，ScanNet/ScanNet++/ARKitScenes；VSI128帧、ReVSI64帧，主要ablation16帧；对照exact v1。 以下结果为作者报告：作者修正VSI平均74.4→75.3，absolute distance64.1→65.8、relative direction88.4→94.0；count75.0→73.4。（v1/v2 Table1, p.7）；v2 ReVSI仍54.5，novel view mIoU44.7%，best-input-copy35.6%。（Table2 p.8; Sec.4.3 p.9） 对照范围：与archived v1全文比较识别19项token diff，科学差异集中Table1及解释；原benchmark baselines与protocol未变。 消融与诊断：geometry/semantic互补，RGB supervision对低层correspondence更强，semantic对高层reasoning更强；本轮消融表未变。
analysis.insightZh: 原auxiliary task要求geometry与semantics协同，而不是简单加geometry encoder；此次新颖性是实质结果更正，方法无变化。
analysis.evidenceZh: semantic auxiliary并行预测grid，避免teacher-forced标签邻接shortcut。（Sec.3.2, pp.4–5; Fig.2, p.4）；v2 Table1 Qwen平均75.3，v1为74.4；多个category修正且非全提升。（Table 1, p.7; archived v1 Table1 p.7; work/audit/2610.05417v2.worker1-scientific-delta.json）；语义辅助对两backbone三个任务有增益，但移除geometry属于off-distribution诊断。（Table 3, p.8; Sec.4.3, p.9）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 保持已收录geometry-grounded VLM结论与exact evidence一致，版本更正应可追溯。
analysis.caveatZh: 仅有限室内scene规模，尚需更多场景与规模。；v2未解释主表更新原因，不能将+0.9称为新增训练方法收益。；9类coarse grid与室内数据限制外推；count等子项下降。
